facts.fact: Interior Cabinet Secretary Kipchumba Murkomen said on 1 April 2026 that the government was procuring a digital Occurrence Book, to be launched soon, through which a crime could be reported from home or at the scene; it is described as to be acquired, not in use.
As of 1 April 2026 the Interior Cabinet Secretary said the digital Occurrence Book was still in a procurement process and yet to be launched; no station is said to be using one.
The Interior Cabinet Secretary said on 1 April 2026 that the government was itself procuring the digital Occurrence Book.
On 1 April 2026 the Interior Cabinet Secretary announced that a procurement to acquire a digital Occurrence Book was in progress and that it would be launched soon.

systems.tiers: Not stated; in procurement in April 2026
